primary.accuracy_definition: Exact match to stored canonical solution, including capped returns. Certified accuracy, correct capped returns, validity, compatibility and given-given conflicts reported separately.
primary.wrong_certificate_definition: Invalid Sudoku completion or clue violation. Valid noncanonical completions reported separately; no unproved uniqueness assumption.
primary.interval_scope: Three marginal nominal95% intervals, no simultaneous-coverage claim.
primary.uncertainty: 32 independent source-bank/noise/tie draws with one independently drawn shuffle and paired search seed per bank. The same10000puzzles repeat acrossbanks. Bootstrap uncertainty is approximate, not a universal guarantee.

search_mapping.rule: Same complete weight16 bytes and search seed; all inputs and other settings fixed by protocol.

bootstrap_validation.scope: Audit-only reformulation, same RNG row/puzzle draws and exact integer totals; no training or search changes.

limitations: Positive weights preserve zero set; they cannot increase canonical certificate capacity.
